postgres.//: Read-only Neon queries. RECOMMENDED: create a separate read-only Postgres role for MCP use and put that connection string in POSTGRES_URL_READONLY.

//stripe.//: Stripe MCP — DISABLED by default. To enable: create a RESTRICTED API key (rk_*, not sk_*) at https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys with read-only permissions for the resources you need (customers, charges, payment_intents, etc.). Store as STRIPE_RESTRICTED_KEY in .env.local. Then uncomment by renaming this key to 'stripe' (drop the //) and removing the //api-key value below.
